statement: No actual host trace has shown the pinned Linux Switch 2 Pro input node, BTN_GRIPR/BTN_GRIPL/BTN_C events, SDL native Share/C/paddle visibility, access grants, HID/USB driver contention or output/IMU behavior for the selected firmware and model. The existing switch2-linux-exposure-unknown therefore remains open for physical host observation despite now documented source-declared evdev capabilities.
